errors.quote: The first $b+1\le K$ rounds process bits one at a time, exactly, costing $O(TpdK)$.
errors.problem: The rounds on prefix slots are not the first $b+1$ rounds. The paper (proof of the transform layout lemma) processes the round at $h=\ell-1$ on the long axes first, then the $qK$ chunk rounds $h=\ell-2,\dots,b$ with the fast layer, and finally the bottom positions $h=b-1,\dots,0$. So the bit-by-bit rounds are the first one and the last $b$. The count $b+1\le K$ and the cost are unaffected.

errors.quote: The contraction $\mathcal T_+$ adds error below $\delta$, so $\|\widetilde h-\mathcal T_+z_*\|_\infty<3\delta+\eta$.
errors.problem: The exact contraction $\mathcal T_+$ adds no error. In the paper, the computed opposite procedure has its own error $<\delta$ on input $\widetilde z$, and the contraction property of $\mathcal T_+$ keeps the propagated error $\|\mathcal T_+(\widetilde z-z_*)\|\le2\delta+\eta$. The paper combines these by the triangle inequality.

errors.quote: one truncation gives $\|\widetilde z-z_*\|_\infty<2\delta+\eta$ ... $\|\widetilde h-\mathcal T_+z_*\|_\infty<3\delta+\eta$
errors.problem: $\widetilde z$, $z_*$ and $\widetilde h$, and the exact and returned forward outputs $u,v,\widetilde u,\widetilde v$ behind them, are never defined on the page. The paper sets $z_*=P(u,v)$ and $\widetilde z=Q_p(P(\widetilde u,\widetilde v))$, and takes $\widetilde h$ to be the returned opposite output.
